subject.title: feat(dashboard): plugin-declared widget data bindings and action verbs

question: Should `dashboard.dataBindings` and `dashboard.actionVerbs` become a supported long-term plugin manifest contract, rather than remaining an internal WorkBoard integration seam?
rationale: The branch adds a new external plugin API and persistent authorization namespace. The correct public contract, compatibility promise, and extension scope require maintainer intent rather than mechanical review alone.

options.title: Approve the manifest seam
options.body: Adopt the declarative manifest capability contract and require focused compatibility and lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the bridge private
options.body: Limit WorkBoard integration to an internal or owner-specific path until the broader plugin API is designed separately.

options.title: Defer the API decision
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define the dashboard plugin-extension contract and migration expectations.

recommendation.title: Approve the manifest seam
recommendation.body: Adopt the declarative manifest capability contract and require focused compatibility and lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR commits show steipete authored the proposed dashboard/plugin contract; a full current-main ownership trail was unavailable in the restricted review environment.
